scope: Exploratory encoder-capacity comparison; previously viewed regression sets, not independent confirmation
hypothesis: A deeper and wider compact pretrained encoder improves personal versus public-context discrimination and boundary transfer without abandoning CPU-only deployment

candidate.revision_provenance: Upstream safetensors conversion refs/pr/2; immutable commit verified through repository API
candidate.licence_status: Base repository declares Apache-2.0; derived weights and training corpus require redistribution review

training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum calibration token loss, same as typed Tiny control

comparison.baseline: Previously trained typed Tiny v2, unchanged weights
comparison.primary_selection: Maximum calibration weighted recall subject to <=2% character over-redaction AND >=98% clean negative documents; no feasible threshold means no primary candidate
comparison.quantization: Dynamic INT8, then recalibrate the exact quantized artifact
comparison.report: All calibration rows, paired 1000-round cluster intervals, full-document protection, per-label failures, accuracy transfer and artifact size
comparison.prohibition: No test-driven hyperparameter or decoder change represented as confirmatory; no promotion without full independent release evidence
